revisions.summary: Initial specification. Defines the file header, tile table and metadata blocks; the universal block header and its recovery tags; the array and byte-array primitives; layer extents and tile offsets; attributes, associated images, ICC colour profiles and annotations. Establishes little-endian dense packing, the derived-offset rule, and the append-only versioning invariant.

Adds focal-plane support (Z_PLANES on the layer extent entry, MICRONS_PLANE spacing), a configurable tile edge length (TILE_LENGTH), a self-describing tile frame (optional, except on a Z-stacked layer), a clinical metadata block reached by a new METADATA offset, carrying a stream whose serialization -- HL7 v2, FHIR as JSON, or FastFHIR -- is declared by an ENCODING field rather than inferred from the bytes, and redefines METADATA_I2S as Iris Interoperability Specification conformance, with the I2S version carried in ATTRIBUTES.VERSION packed as major << 8 | minor (decided 2026-11-25, so a writer and a reader cannot pack the two halves differently). The two metadata channels divide by shape as well as by subject: laboratory metadata is key-value and stays in the attribute arrays under I2S or DICOM, while the clinical resource graph goes in the stream. Only the stream carries identity, so a slide is de-identified by dropping it alone. Retires IMAGE_ENCODING_PNG and ANNOTATION_PNG through the new deprecated marking (decided 2026-11-24, so readers and writers implement fewer encodings): their values stay assigned, writers shall not emit them, a reader may refuse one by naming it, and SVG is the preferred annotation encoding. States that patient identity belongs only in the clinical metadata stream, under every attribute FORMAT (decided 2026-11-24, so that dropping the stream alone de-identifies the slide); METADATA_I2S attributes hold only facts of the slide fixed when it was scanned. Reassigns tile encoding value 3, a member of the 1.0 group, from AVIF to TILE_ENCODING_AV1 (decided 2026-11-25; the value is reassigned in place rather than deprecated because no file in use carries the AVIF tile encoding, an exception to append-only that the specification's owner sanctioned and that tests/wire/README.md records): the tile byte-stream is a bare AV1 sequence in the Low Overhead Bitstream Format with no container, one shown frame per focal plane, and a single-plane tile is one key frame. IMAGE_ENCODING_AVIF, the associated-image encoding, is unchanged. Adds the GPU block-compressed tile encodings TILE_ENCODING_UASTC (4) and TILE_ENCODING_XUASTC (5) (decided 2026-11-25, so a reader can transcode tiles to the GPU's block format instead of decoding them to pixels): each tile byte-stream is a bare codec stream with no KTX2 or other container, UASTC LDR 4x4 blocks in raster order under one Zstandard frame, or one XUASTC LDR bitstream; each carries one focal plane. Adds TILE_TABLE.MIP_LEVELS (decided 2026-11-25, so the count is recorded once for the slide instead of adding bytes to every tile's frame): a UASTC stream's one Zstandard frame holds that many levels back to back, finest first, each level's offset computed from TILE_LENGTH; XUASTC carries level 0 alone, since its bitstream records no total length by which concatenated levels could be split. Requires every TILE_ENCODING_AV1 stream's first sequence header to declare 8-bit 4:2:0 or 4:4:4 colour with the BT.601 matrix at full range, one operating point, frames of exactly TILE_LENGTH square with superres off, and no film grain (decided 2026-11-26, so every frame of an AV1 tile decodes to the same RGB as a JPEG tile, at the tile's size); colorimetry stays with the ICC profile. XUASTC's further levels, its block footprint and the stability of its bitstream are open.
